cards.name: Summer PLUS
cards.description: Children participate in arts and crafts, games, indoor and outdoor physical activities, story time, science activities and dramatic play. The program also includes pool visits, field trips and educational presenters.

hours.text: Drop off time is no later than 9:00 am.

prices.label: Non-refundable enrollment fee per child; includes a T-shirt

financial_aid.text: Families receiving financial assistance from DSS must check with DSS to see if a new voucher is needed for each school year and for Summer PLUS care. DSS funding is limited and is not always available.

lunch.text: Students must bring or purchase their lunches. Students receiving Free or Reduced-Price lunches during the school year remain eligible through the Summer PLUS program.

cards.review_notes: The 2025–2026 Flex calendar lists June 1–26 Summer Plus @ HES; only this documented site and date range are included, and other district summer sites or later dates may be missing. The weekly-fees page states $140/week effective July 1, 2025, while the 2026–2027 school-year page states $155/week and was modified July 1, 2026. The $140 rate is retained for the documented June 2026 dates; confirm the summer 2027 rate before publication. General eligibility and the $60 Summer PLUS enrollment fee are stated on the undated annual-enrollment page, not in a summer-specific 2027 announcement.
